initialization_contract.handeye: P3 board observations only, shared across rows/folds
initialization_contract.cube_pose_initialization: current fold's train Cube observations only
initialization_contract.B2_scope: board residual ablation; P3 board-derived initialization retained

mechanical_fk.reason: 선택한 Cube의 비전 미사용 T_flange_cube 입력이 없음. robot.json pose는 T_base_flange이며 flange-to-Cube 장착 변환이 아님. 다른 Cube의 nominal 기계 변환은 재사용하지 않음.

corrected_fk_training.role: P1 training artifact for initialization, A4/A5/B1/B2 corrected-FK and common Cube reference; forbidden as A3 mechanical FK
corrected_fk_training.collection: one rigid Cube grasp, multiple airborne positions and rotations
corrected_fk_training.grasp_model: one constant T_flange_cube (grasp_id=0); regrasp repeatability not measured
corrected_fk_training.train_reprojection_source_conversion: component-wise solver RMSE multiplied by sqrt(2)
corrected_fk_training.nominal_rotation_status: 선택한 Cube에 다른 Cube의 nominal 회전을 적용하지 않음

metric_contracts.all: all placements를 한 번에 fit한 calibration으로 전체 session2 cube를 평가; train+test 평균이 아니라 full-data descriptive fit
metric_contracts.train: 각 leave-one-placement-out fold의 calibration-train placements 평가; 모든 fold의 평가 corner를 합쳐 RMSE 계산
metric_contracts.heldout_test: 각 fold에서 calibration에 넣지 않은 한 placement만 평가; 해당 P2 Cube와 Board 관측을 모두 fit에서 제외; test-time calibration refit 없음
metric_contracts.cube_reprojection: 모든 row가 같은 P1 train-VISION corrected-FK reference T_base_cube를 사용한 sqrt(mean(dx^2 + dy^2)), pooled-corner pixel RMSE; corrected-FK 방법에 구조적으로 유리하므로 내부 보조 지표
metric_contracts.cross_view: source camera PnP만 destination으로 양방향 전달; destination corner는 scoring에만 사용; sqrt(mean(dx^2 + dy^2)), pooled-corner pixel RMSE; fixed-fixed uses no Robot FK, fixed-gripper includes Robot FK
metric_contracts.external_gt: 별도 blind pose에서 frozen prediction과 독립 T_base_cube_GT를 비교한 TRE_mm, rotation_error_deg, P95_TRE_mm, failure_rate; 최종 순위 지표

cross_view.definition: source camera measurement-only PnP transferred to destination; destination observation used only for scoring; both directions
